༄༅/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod bcu gnyis pa bzhugs so//
lge/ /bter spon chen po ris 'dzin zong kyi lem 'pha can nam ris 'dzin ngangos gab rgyal mtshan mi/ bod rab byung drug pa'i me glang dku cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu/ spyi lo 1337lor ga / tsho / / / / sa / da su / / / / / ༄ / /g.yas ru stod byang ga zang zang lha brag gi 'dabs rol ri rgyal bkra bzang gi mdun du bkra shis pa' ltas bcas sku 'khrungs/ thugs rigs sad de zab mo gter 'don pa'i dus la bab nas brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'am lha brag nas bod khams bde zhing mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i chos skor rnams bse sgrom smug mmu mdzod lnga'i nang nas rdzogs chen kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal gyis mtshon pa'i zab chos rmad du byung ba chos tshan brgya phrag lnga lhag spyan drangs shing shog ser las gtan la phab nas skal ldan las can rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad/ de bzhin gu ru padma'i sbas yul 'bras ljongs sogs su gnas sgo mang du tyā ba gnang nga/ 4 bstsod 'dzin ni sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po dang khrim mtshan ldan ma spruX pa'i 〉spra sbyin/ kun spaX don sbyod rgyal mtshan sogs thugazi kyi sras bdun/ las can gyi gang zag sum stong gtso
༄tshi/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam bcu gnyis pa'i nang bzhugs/ shar dung mdzod dkar po nas byon pa'i bka' brgyad pod bzhi pa la/ drag po rang byung rang shar gyi gzhung khrid lus kyi srog shing /30 (1) bcom ldan 'das bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i phrin las che ba/23 (61) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi bstod byang bkol ba/3 (107) sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi 'dzab byang bkol ba/6 (113) bka' brgyad shes bya bcu'i mdo 'gag ces bya ba/11 (125) bka' brgyad kyi dam can yongs rdzogs sgos bskul/11 (153) dmod byang bkol ba/ 4 (175) rgyud chen le'u nyer drug pa'i le'u bcu gnyis pa sgrub pa chen po'i bsgom khog chung ba/2 (183) dpal dgu'i bstod pa/5 (187) dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba sta gon dang bcas pa/2 (197) bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchod pa phud kyi skong ba 'bring po/5 (201) ma mo bdun tshan gyi gser skyems/5 (211) bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi rdzogs rim lnga pa/5 (221) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi bcud len bdud rtsi'i phreng

༄tsho/ /bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs la/2 (477) drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i rgyud las sngags byang zur du bkol bar/6 (481) drag po rang byung rang shar gyi pho nya sgos bskul 'bring por/9(493) skal bzang padma dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i bka' brgyad rang shar gyi tshe'i phrin las kyi lhan thabs rdo rje'i srog shing la/4 (511) sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi bka'i bstan srung gi sgrub skor la/15 (519)skong bshags kyi khrigs rim lag len kun tshang la/3 (549) sgrub chen bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi ser srung la/7 (555) bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar gyi tshe spra brtag par/2 (569) bka' brgyad drag po'i kha ba srung bar/2 (573) bka' brgyad khro bo rol pa'i gtor ma'i dpe'u ris/3 (577) par byang smon tshig1 (583—584) bcas bzhugs/ chos tshul 'di yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun du grags gyur te/ /blo gros padmo rab tu rgyas byed cing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par the ga /dge'o// //
༄tsho: rtsa ba sdong po lta bu'i khrid: gyesapa yal ga lta bu'i khrid: 'bar ba me tog lta bu'i khrid: smin pa 'bras bu lta bu'i khrid thams cad 'di latshang ngo:drag po rang byung rang shar gyi gzhung khrid lusakyi srog shing lta bu bzhugs se1 theg pa thams cad kyi srog 'disazin pa'o:
༄tshicaX kun bzang che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo'oX skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag gisacaX mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la bsten te phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rdzogs par nod pa'i dus su'oX rig pa rang grol gyi rtags tshad la phebs shingacaX slar de'i don ma nyams par bya ba'i phyir du'oX shin tu dben pa'i gnas su dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad bsags lacaX nam 'chi nges pa med pa'i dran pas yang dang yang du bskul te'oX skyes bu'i snying la mda' zug pa lta bu'i skyo shas drag pos dam pa'i chos la 'bad par bya zhingacaX rang byung rang shar kyis don la yang dang yang du ma yengs par bskyang ngo'oX gal te rig pa rang 〈snal gyi rtags tshad la ma phebs na nicaX thabs sna tshogs kyis lam la gzud par bya stecaX de'ang rgyud lasacaX de phyir sems can las mang bsacaX gdul bya sna tshogs bstan par bya'oX gsang
༄༅caX sngags snod du rung ba lacaX dgongs pa ma bcos lhug par bstana'oX theg pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyangacaX thams cad blo yi 'khrid thabs yina'oX zhes gsungs pasacaX gang zag rigs can gsum rtsol med du grol bar bya ba'i phyiracaX mas rim gyis 'khrid par bya stecaX rgyud lasacaX dbang po tha ma'i tha ma lacaX drang don skye lha'i sdug bsngal bshadacaX gdams ngag zer ba'ang 'dug ces gsungs pa'i dona'oX'jig rten na skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal tshan po che gcig bshams la gcig 'greng ba chu'i ri mo lta bur bud pa dang song dus med pa'i las la spyod pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can gyi khams la yang dang yang du bsam zhingacaX rang rgyud la blangs te'oX thun drug tu dben par bsgom du gzhugacaX rjes thob tu sdug bsngal tshan po che 'di bdag gis sdug bsngal du ma shes pas na rgal thog tu 'bab pa 'di bzod
par 'dug gamagiX bla ma jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol4༷༷ sdug bsngal gyi ngo shes par byin gyis brlab tu gsol4༷༷ skye rga na 'chi'i 'dam rdzab chen po 'di las thar bar mdzad du gsol4༷༷ 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba thob par mdzad du gsol4༷༷ zhes brgya rtsa re thun re re la zhe thag pa nas gsol ba btabaltoX thun mtshams su sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras la bsam stegiX thos bsam la 'bad par bya zhingagiX 'dod yon drug gi yul mi gtsang ba'i khang khyim mamagiX skyugs nad can gyi mig sngar zas bstan pa lta bugiX skyo shas long long ba gang la yang yid mi 'jug pa bu gces shi ba'i ma lta bur song na4༷༷ thar pa'i lam rtsa nges 'byung skyes pa yin pas ma skyes bar du 'khrid par bya'ogiX de nas gnyis pa nigiX rgyud las4༷༷ dbang po tha ma'i bar pa la4༷༷ rgyu 'bras las kyi 'dor len bstan4༷༷ zhes gsungs pa'i don4༷༷ dben pa'i gnas su khrid degiX mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bde sdug gnyis kyi yo lang du ling nge ba 'di ci las byung na4༷༷ dkar nag gi las kyi rgyu la bstan nas4༷༷ 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis su smin pa yin la4༷༷ des na khams gsum na skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal4༷༷ rigs drug so so'i rten la grangs dang rtsis gdab med par spyod dgos pa 'diljoX las mi dge ba'i 'bras bur 'dug pas gnas skabs su mtho ris kyi bde ba dngagiX
༄tshiltoX mthar thug thar pa'i bde ba 'di yang dge ba'i 'bras bur 'dug pas4༷༷ las rgyu 'bras phra zhing rab tu phra ba tsam la yang blang dor du bya bar rigs pa la4༷༷ e mgiX mi shes shing bag mi ldan pa'i sems can 'di dag bde ba dang nam 'phrad na4༷༷ sdug bsngal dang nam bral na snyam du bsam zhing rang rgyud la blang ste bsgomagiX thun mtshams sugiX bla ma jo bo daskardzon mchog gsum po4༷༷ khams gsum gyi sems can bag med pa 'di dag la dgongs su gsol4༷༷ 'di dag dge ba'i las la bsam pa brtan por sgyur du gsol4༷༷ mi dge ba'i las dang bsam pa ngan pa bzlog tu gsol4༷༷ blang dor la rmongs pa 'di dag blang dor shes par mdzad du gsol4༷༷ zhes brgya rtsa re zhe thag pa nas gsol ba btabaltoX thun mtshams su nges 'byung dang rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len gyi bya ba thos bsam la 'bad par bya'ogiX de'i tshe srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las la mi 'jug cingagiX lus sems ngal ba brjod pa dngagiX dam pa'i chos spyod pa dngagiX rgyu 'bras phra mo tsam la'ang mig gi rdul ltar blang dor shes pa byung na thar pa'i lam rtsa tshugs pa yin pas4༷༷ ma skyes bar du 'khrid par bya'ogiXde nas gsum pa nigiX rgyud las4༷༷ dbang po tha ma'i dang po la4༷༷ chos kun sems su 'dus pa yigiX dbu ma sems tsam lta ba bstan4༷༷ zhes gsungs pas4༷༷ dben pa'i gnas dwangs shong yid du 'ong b.raltoX bde ba'i
stan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis4༷༷ yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dngagiX sems can gyi don du smon 'jug gi bsam pa brtan po bskyed la4༷༷ yan lag bdun pa byas te4༷༷ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thims par bsres la lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos par lhod de bltoX shig ge bltoX sal le bltoX seng nge bltoX rjen ne bltoX ye re bltoX ma yengs par bzhag gogiX de'i tshe lus sems bde seng nge bltoX shes pa stong bun ne ba'i nyams rgyud la shar ba'i rjes sugiX tshogs drug gi yul snang rgya chem me bltoX gsal ba zhig yong la4༷༷ de dag ni byed pa gzhan gyis byas pa med dogiX cha'amagiX dbang phyug gamagiXtshangs pa'amagiX khyab 'jug la sogs pa byed pa po4༷༷ sgro btags rnams kyang rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul du snang ba yin na4༷༷ de dag gis byas pa'i ri rab khang khyim dngagiX skyes pa bud med rta glang dngagiX 'byung bzhi dang des bskyed pa'i rtsi shing nags tshal ljon shing me tog 'bras bugiX sman dang de'i ro nus thams cad kyang rang gi sems kyi rol pa'amagiX rtsal snang tsam du ma 'dus par logs su chad par ci yang med degiX dper na mig phye ba tsam na snang ba khra cham mer gsal ba skurdzod la4༷༷ mig btsum pas yid yul du lam mer shar ba ltaraltoX snang ba sems su 'dus par thag bcad degiX sems nyid rnam par bden pa dngagiX rnam par rdzun pa
༄tshiltoX tsam du 'dod pa'i lam las drangs te4༷༷ mthar mnyam bzhag tu chos thams cad skye ba med pa 'gags pa med pagiX gnas pa med pagiX 'gro ba med pagiX 'ong ba med pagiX rjes thob tu yul thams cad rnam par snang bltoX skye ba dang bcas pagiX rga ba dang bcas pagiX na ba dang bcas pagiX 'chi ba dang bcas pa 'di rnams nigiX rten cing kun tu rnam par 'brel ba can te4༷༷ bdag thog ma med pa nas don dam par 'khor ba zhes bya ba grub pa med pa la4༷༷ glo bur gyi dri mas 'khrul pa'i snang ba la rigs drug gi gnas rnams su 'khyams yun ring ba'i dbang gis4༷༷ ji tsam du skyes pa de tsam du res pha byas pagiX res ma byas pagiX res bu dang bu mo byas pagiX de tsam du phan pa rnams la ni 'bad pas sbyin sbyin pagiX gnod pa rnams ni 'bad pas bsal bsal bltoX da 'di dag ma skyes pa dang mi 'gag pa'i don ni ma rtogs4༷༷ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa'i sdug bsngal can mi bden pa la bden par bzung bas sdug bsngal ba 'di rnams snying re rje na4༷༷ 'di dag bde ba dang 'phrad na ñtsu ma rung sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya4༷༷ sdug bsngal med pa'i mchog gi bde ba dang ldan par gyur nas4༷༷ nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cigagiX 'di dag gi don du bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bya4༷༷ de'i phyir du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi
lam la gnas shing bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam du bsams shing ngag tu brjod pas4༷༷ dmyal ba'i me nang du myur du 'jug par nus pa'i bsam pa bzang po skyes na kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems phan sems kyi rtsa ba can rgyud la skyes pa yin te4༷༷ slar yul dang yul 'dzin gyi shes pa'igiX rang bzhin la kha nang du log ste mnyam par bzhag pas snang ba sems su rtogs4༷༷ sems sgyu ma'i rta glang tsam du rtogs4༷༷ de rten cing 'brel bar rtogs4༷༷rten 'brel smra bsam brjod med du rtogs te4༷༷ ma rnyed pa'i don dam rtag chad kyi mtha' las grol bar 'gyur ro4༷༷ thun mtshams bla ma jo bo dkon mchog gsum po dgongs su gsol4༷༷ rang bzhin med pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag 'khrul pa'i lam las bzlog tu gsol4༷༷ gzugs la sogs pa tshogs drug gi snang ba stong pa nyid kyi cho 'phrul du rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol4༷༷ stong nyid kyi rang rtsal rigs drug gi 'gro ba 'di dag skye med du grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol4༷༷ skye 'gags gnyis med kyi gnas lugs bdag dang 'gro kun gyi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol4༷༷ zhes brgya rtsa re thun re la zhe thag pa nas sgyu ma lta bu'i dran pas gsol ba btabaltoX thun mtshams su sgyu ma lta bu'i dran pas las dge ba bcu la 'bad dogiX de'i tshe snying rje phan sems shas mi bzod pa shugs kyis skyedagiX des dran pa'i rang bzhin spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i
༄tsholtoX nyams lhan lhan rgyud la 'charaltoX rgyu 'bras la yid ches4༷༷ stong nyid kyi ming thos pa tsam la dga' ba skye4༷༷ dmyal bar 'jug pa la yang nyam nga med pa'i snying rje 'char ba 'byung bas4༷༷ ma skyes bar du khrid par bya'ogiX de dag gis ni theg pa thun mong ba'i khrid thar pa'i sa bon gtsang ma yin la4༷༷ gsang sngags kyi zhing sa lta bu yin no4༷༷ bzhi pa nigiX de lta bu'i don rgyud la skyes pa'i dus sugiX gang zag dbang po 'bring du gyur pa yin te4༷༷ de'i lam spyod pas skyong dgos te4༷༷ de'ang rgyud las4༷༷ dbang po 'bring gi tha ma la4༷༷ byang chub sems dpa'i ldem dgongs dngagiX bden pa gnyis kyi chos rnams ston4༷༷ zhes gsungs pas dang por byams pa bsgomagiX de nas snying rje bsgomagiX de nas smon pa'i sems sbyangs4༷༷ bzod pa'i lam la blo legs par 'byongs pa'i gang zag gis kun rdzob tu chos thams cad la dad par bya4༷༷ mos par bya4༷༷ goms par byas te sems can gyi skyabs dang mgon dang lam dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa byas te4༷༷ legs par khong du chud par byas pa'i sbyor bas dge ba'i chos spel bar byas te4༷༷ don du gyur ba dag yin na ni sdig pa ltar snang ba kun yang drogs pa med par spyad cing rkyen ngan pa thams cad byang chub kyi lam du 'khyer ba la 'bad par bya4༷༷ don dam du chos thams cad la mi rtog cing rnam par mi rtog pa dngagiX khas mi len cing gang du'ang nye bar

rten 'dir/ /byon tshe ma mar rab bsngags ngang mo'i mdog /phyag gnyis dri med gos 'dzin zhabs pus btsug/ /skye dgu'i bdag mo nyid la gsol =/ /dga' rab rdo rje skyed mdzad yum chen mo/ /rab dkar spyan gsum dmar ser ral pas brjid/ /phyag gnyis pad steng rin chen 'bar ba bsnams/ /mkha' 'gro bde ldan ma la =/ /nye ba'i sras chen mang po'i bde skyed yum/ /mthing nag gri gug thod 'dzin gzig sham can dur khrod che dbus 'khri shing 'bras can la/ /sku rten ring byed bde mar =/ /'jam dpa' bshes gnyen 'khor gyi thog ma la/ /dmar ser zhal zas gzhong thogs bram ze'i chul/ /'khor bcas bla ma'i dgyes pa skong mdzad pa/ /yid bzhin dpal zhes grags la =/ /int+ra bhu ti dgyes pa'i mdun gros pa/ /dkar dmar padma ltar mdzes bum pa bsnams/ /gos dkar lwa ba'i thod can gtsug rgyan 'dzin/ /chos blon blo gros mchog la =/ /rang byung sprul sku mtsho dbus sku bltams tshe/ /bdud rtsi'i khrus gsol rin chen gzhong pa bsnams/ /dkar dmar mdangs mdzes sprin gseb rol pa'i nyams/ /byang sems nam mkha'i snying por =/ /rgyal sras mchog de nub phyogs o rgyan gyi/ /rgyal srid chos kyis skyong tshe sbas pa'i 'khor/ /beeḍūrya sngon mdog can nor bu 'dzin/ /sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la =/ /bsil ba'i tshal du brtul zhugs mdzad
༄༅/ /nas su/ /mkha' 'gro'i chos 'khor bskor tshe las byed pa/ /rab dkar smar smin ral pa dmar ser mdog /chos chul 'chad pa'i rdo rjer =/ /ma la ya ru o rgyan nyid byon tshe/ /sde brgyad gtsor gyur rin chen thugs rgyud bskul/ /mthing nag rdor dril sdigs mdzub zhing lpags gsol/ /drag po gtum po nyid la =/ /dur khrod brgyad du rol pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ /chos kyi sras gyur bshes gnyen ras dmar gsol/ /mdog dkar dam tshig glegs bam mchan 'og 'dzin/ /shākya mai tri'i zhabs la gsol =/ /brag dmar bya khyung tshal du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /kun dga' bo la lhan cig mdo sde'i tshogs/ /thugs chud rab byung dkar dmar glegs bam 'degs/ /nyan thos zhi ba'i snying por =/ /mā ra ti gar gu ru chen po yis/ /bde skyed yum gcig mu tig gsar pa'i mdog /phyag g.yon bum pa dgyes pa'i gar mdzad tshul/ /yid 'dzin lha mor grags la =/ /rang byung sprul sku bde stong ye shes la/ /rol tshe bdud rtsis mnyes mdzad rgyu skar mdog /phyag g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa g.yon 'thor tshul/ /chang 'tshong bī na sa mor =/ /gtsug lag 'dzin nyid gtsug lag zung gcig gis/ /bstan pa skyong tshe sngo sangs gos dkar can/ /phyag gnyis yi ge'i 'du byed byed pa'i tshul/ /chos blon ye shes gsal la =/ /o rgyan rgyal po padmas rjes bzung tshe/ /bde skyed btsun
mo 'od 'chang dkar gsal 'dzum/ /ngur smrig rtags 'chang rdo leb mdzes pa'i khrir/ /phyag gnyis 'khor lo 'dzin la =/ /o rgyan yul gru bcu drug skyong mdzad tshe/ /chos 'khor bskul mdzad bka' 'dus bsdu ba mdzad rgyal po'i cha byad dung dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas nyid la =/ /rdo rje gdan du mu stegs tshar bcad tshe/ /rgyas gdab zab gter gu ru'i phyag tu phul/ /sngo bsangs gter gyi sgrom bu 'bul ba'i tshul/ /gar gyi dbang phyug mkha' 'gror gsol =/ /rgyal po klu yi khyab 'jug 'dul ba'i tshe/ /bde mchog dus kyi snying po'i mar gyur pa/ /dkar mo rin chen rgyan ldan ḍā dril 'dzin/ /lha mo bde 'byung gnyis par =/ /ma gha dha yi rdo rje'i gdan chen po'i/ /zhabs tog mchog brtson ded dpon ka kha 'dzin/ /dge bsnyen cha lugs bdug sbos mar me thogs/ /ghandho lar bzhugs khyed la =/ /yang le rtsodad nas phrin las phur pa yi/ /rgyud kun len pa'i pho nyar rab bsngags pa/ /dge bsnyen tshul 'dzin glegs bam khur g.yon brtsegs/ /bal po dzi na mi trar =/ /has po ri la me therdzor phur bus zlog /phrin las bka' babs dbu skra'i lan phran dkar/ /phur bu sdigs tshul rakta'i phreng ba 'dren/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms zhabs la =/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i lung thob nas/ /mkhyen pa rmad byung lo tsā rab byung tshul/ /thal sbyor
༄༅/ /utpal dkar po'i yu ba 'dzin/ /khro 81 byams pa dpal la =/ /gu ru'i thugs tig man ngag kun gyi bdag /rgod kyi ldem 'phru la sogs rtags cu gsum/ /yongs rdzogs sa gnon mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can dngos grub rgyal mtshan gang der =/ /sprul pa nyer lnga ston las kun gyi gtso/ /mang bkur rigs 'khrungs bgres tshul dbang chas ldan/ /chos 'chad mnyam bzhag steng na glegs bam 'dzin/ /legs ldan rdo rje'i zhabs la =/ /rtsod dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mun gling 'dir/ /gsang chen chos kyi sgron me gcig pu pa/ /rdo rje thod 'dzin dbang rtags cod paṇa can/ /ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la =/ /slar yang bi shwa ḍākki'i lung bzhin du/ /lha rigs sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /chos gos rnam gsum gang zhu rdor dril can/ /padma phrin las zhabs la =/ /e ma lam zhugs so so'i skye kro rnams/ /sems dpa' chen po'i rjes slob 'ong ba nyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go sar byon zin nas/ /skye gnas 'chi 'pho'i srid pa ston 'di mtshar/ /cung zad brtags tshe mchog gi sprul sku rnams/ /'jig rten pa dang mthun par rjes ston tshe/ /sems can rnams kyi spyod tshul ci 'dra ba'i/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i tshul mthong dad pas g.yos/ /shin tu brtags tshe kho bo'i bla ma 'di'i/ /ci mdzad ye shes rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul la/ /legs nyes brtag pa 'dzin pa'ang
sems can pa'i/ /'khrul rtog nyid yin chos sku'i ngang du gcig /thugs yid dbyer med bsres pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /bla ma'i ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs dang/ /dbyer med 'dres nas gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi / / don mthong 'bad med rang don lhun grub shog /dge'o// //
༄tsho/ /sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog lag len don sdeb bklag chog rig 'dzin nyi zla 'od zer gyisabasdebasapa bzhugs so//

༄tshi/ /nub kyi dmar mo ma bdun gyis : oX badzra tsa mun tri bhyo dzaX su ta ma bhyo dzaX ba ru ṇa bhyo dzaX ma hā kā la na bhyo dzaX tsa ki li ma bhyo dzaX sar ka na bhyo dzaX lam bho dha ra ma bhyo dzaX byang gi sngon mo ma bdun gyis za mjug sgro brgyad la oX badzra zhi ma ti kro ti shwa ri ho za byed mas ltas : ka ma la kro ti shwa ri dzaX rmod byed mas : ka ma la kro ti shwa ri lhagiX tshe 'phel mas : ka ma la kro ti shwa ri rbadagiX skye shi rtsad gcod mas : ka ma la kro ti shwa ri bhyoX khams gsum dbang sdud mas : klo ti shwa ri bhyoX bde 'gro : shintaX bhyoX nyi zla thod phreng mas : mu tri bhyoX dbyings sgrog mas shan tri bhyoX rgyan gyi rgyal mos : dun tri bhyoX bdud rtsi mas ca na tri bhyoX phung byed mas : sur ya kro ti bhyoX nyi ma khros mas : u tsi ma bhyoX padma mkha' 'gro mas za badzra kaX pu bhyoX khams gsum 'tshams byed mas : ni la ma bhyoX srid pa bde sbyor mas : tant+ra ma bhyoX rgyal mo drug gis : dun tri ma bhyoX blon mo bzhis : ma du ris za 'bangs mo 'bum gyis cu gtsug gi nor bu mas : oX badzra yaka sha dza bospoX dza ra sa la rakta ya snying la ste kha la : ma ma ru lu ru lu bhyo ltas cu gnod byed khong dbugs khrol / snying khrag sa ma ya daX raltoX snying rtsa phyungs mā ra ya tsa ti thun4༷༷ snying khrag baX thun shrī tri traXltoX snying pa sa ma ya bhyoX ma ma sha sha ma ma hriXltoX ma ma sa ma ya dgra bo mṛ mā ra ya rbershad sodagiX dgra snying sa ma ya tsitta dzwa la

༄༅/ /bo/ /de ni sngon du 'gro ba'i bca' gzhi'i rim pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi nyams su len pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/ thun mong phrin las gzhung bsrang ba dang / khyad par zlog pa'i phrin las dngos bya'o dang po phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba la gsum ste/ dang po sngags pa rnams kyis bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs che 'bring chung gsum gang yang rung ba'i phrin las gnas skabs dang sbyar la gzhung bsrang bar du rgyu mchog bam gyi bskang ba/ dam rdzas mdangs kyi bskang ba/ dza gad phud kyi bskang ba/ gshegs pa'i las thams cad rdzogs par bya'o/ /tha mar bstod bskul phrin las thams cad ci rigs gnas skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/ /gnyis pa zlog pa'i phrin las dngos bya ba la gsum ste/ dang po snod bcud lnga yi dkyil 'khor du bskyed/ bar du nya bo la dmigs pa'i rten bcas bsgral ba'i las bya ba dang / tha ma bsgral zhing dal gyi lha la bstab cing / mchod bstod thams cad la zung 'jug tu bya'o/ /bar du nya bo la dmigs rten bya ste/ bsgral ba'i las bya ba la gnyis te/ rgyas par lha so so'i gzhung gis bsgral ba dang /bsdus pa dus gcig la bsgral bar bya'o/ /dang po lha so so'i gzhung gis bsgral ba'i las byed na/ nya po re re la dmigs pa'i rten bcas te/ dbus su che mchog gis bsgral ba'i las bya/ shar du yang dag gi
mtshon chas bsgral =/ lhor gshin rje'i 'khor los bsad pa'i las bya/ nub tu dbang chen gyi thog gis bsad : byang du phur pa'i gdab kyis bsad : shar lhor ma mo'i thun gyis bsad : lho nub tu rig 'dzin gyi dbyug thos bsgral : nub byang du 'jig rten gyi dmod pas bsgral ba'i las bya/ byang shar du dregs pa'i dug gis bsad pa'i las bya'o/ /de dag sgrub pa so so'i gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsdus pa dus gcig tu bsgral ba'i thabs byed na/ bdag gis dpal che mchog chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ e badzra maṇḍa la hūṃXltoX zhes pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dal du gyur par bsam / oX badzra shrī he ru ka ma hā kro dha hūṃXltoX zhes pas/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad dal du lam gyis bskyed/ oX badzra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ sarba garma ka ra ya bhyo dzaX zhes khrag 'thung lha dgu'i snying pos las la bskul ba'i sham bu can bzlas pas bsnyen sngags hūṃX dang sgrub sngags brgyad cu pa dang bye brag so rbersha'i sngags sham la/ 6༷ wabadzra sa ma ya hoX badzra sa ma ya dza dzaXdang / las sngags drarsha lnga pa bzlas rbersha/ /gong du snod bcud lha'i dal du bskyed pa de dag thams cad sngon gyi thugs dam las bzhengs nas dmag mi go cha brjes pa ltar/ rngams pa'i dhūX sgra dir gyis las la chas par bsam mo/ /de nas/ rū tra sarba shā hūm̐ mā ra
༄༅/ /ya dzaX zhes pas mdun gyi nya bo/ snod bhanta gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du tri'am mṛ las/ nya bo de dag dgra bgegs gang la bya ba mngon sum du bsam mo/ /de nas brub khung bskyed pa ni/ e ram̐ gnyis brjod pas/ nya kro gnas pa'i snod gnam lcags las grub pa'i e khung gru gsum 'jigs su rung ba shal ma ri'i sdong po/ thal tshan gyi chu kro/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gri'i thang gis bskor ba las nyon gang dgos kyis rab tu 'khrigs pa'i dbus su/ nya bo de nyid bstan pa spyi dang rnal 'byor sgos dgra/ lus rid pa/ skra gzing ba/ byang sems 'dzag pa/ shu bas gang ba/ lus nyid nyams pa/ yan lag khog pa mgon skyabs kun bral/ 'dar sngangs yed par gyur/ na mo zhes/ dkon mchog rgyal ba sgrub gzhung tha dad na bya'o/ /gsum gyi bden pa brjod cing / rten liṅga 'di la khug cig ces tshar gsum brjod/ gser skyems gtor zhing mya/ 'di'i mjug ma tshang bas/ rjesasu dpe rnyed dusabri brko dgos/ ༄tsho/ /kun bzang che mchog zhi khre'i lha la 'dud/ dang po skyabs 'gro nas bzung mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bgegs gtor bya ste phy-i rol du dor/ de nas rgyal chen bzhir gtor ma bzhi dbul/ las byang gzhung bsrang / dbus phyogs 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas dzab bskul yongs rdzogs bya/ bcom ldan kun bzang bde gshegs bstod byang ltar bya/ gtor ma

༄tshi/ /zhal bstab bya ba ni/ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams zhes 'don zhing / yi dam zlog gtor bka' srung bcas gso/ de nas 'jig rten gtor snod sogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa gso khar mar me 'bul/ khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod sogs nas rakta 'phyar ro/ /de nas ling chung gtor chung bcu gsum bsham la rakta bran la/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ka sogs nas mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes zhes liṅga bsgral/ gtor chung bcas bdud rtsis bran la zlog par phul/ sngags kyi gong du dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa zhes rdo rje slob dpon gyis bzlas shing thal mo rdeb/ gzhan mas rnga 'cham bya sngags bzlas de bzhin dpal dgu la de ltar 'gre'o/ /drag sngags brgyad cu ma lan bdun nam skabs dang bstun/ so lnga pa de bzhin bya zhing / gzhung bsrang yang zlog la brgya'am nyer gcig gal dang bstun/ de nas khyung gtor la raktas bran dkar me phul te/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis4༷༷ zhes sogs nas sa ma ya hrī hūṃX phaṭa yan bya rgyas pa slang dgu ma yin na khyung gi mchu byang ni/ smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas4༷༷ zhes nas / the'u rang dmag tshogs dgra la bzlog yan bya zhing bar skabs kyi sngags rnams la khyung gi bsnyen pa sbyar la mang nyung skabs dang bstun cing bzlas/ rgyas par min na ma bton kyang rung / de nas dbus kyi
dpal chen gtor ma'i steng zhes gzhung bsrang / de nas 'bul nyin/ rgyu ni rin chen ngar zan la4༷༷ zhes 'byung ba bzhin nya bo bcu/ zan gyi nya chung ser po bcu/ mchod rten sa sna'i btsun chung bcu/ sha dang zan gyi mtheb kyu bcu/ sha dang zan gyi sho chung bcu/ zan gyi bud med bcu/ skyer pa'i rtsang phur bcu/ rin chen sna tshogs bum pa bcu/ zan dang sbang ma'i gzhong pa bcu/ zan gyi mi mo ral can bcu/ de rnams bca' 'o de nas rtsang bstod bya ba ni/ dpal chen che mchog he ru ka zhes sogs nas/ zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod yan 'don/ de nas rnga mong bcas bshams la/ dpal chen che mchog he ru ka zhes pa nas gzhung bsrangs la khyung zhal bsgyur yan bya'o/ bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor nas zhes khyung zhal bsgyur 'di rgyun du mi dgos shing / las sbyor nyin/ dbus kyi dpal chen gtor ma'i steng zhes/ rgyal mtshan rnam dgu'i gong du khyung zhal bsgyur 'don/ rnga mong mjug tu bong zhon ma la bdag nyid dpal chen che mchog ces nas yongs rdzogs 'don/ de nas glud bya ba ni/ gzhung nas 'byung bzhin bshams la sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ 'chi bdag nag po gshin rje'i gtso zhes lan gsum 'don/ mjug tu zhal phyir bsgyur/ de nas khro rgyal khams gsum hūṃX sgra can zhes gzhung bsrang / bhyos gdab nas dgra
༄tshi/ /bzlog yan bya/ las sbyor nyin ma gtogs mi dgos/ las phran bcu dang rnga mong rnams ma bca' bar rgyal mtshan rnam dgu'i mjug tu rtsang bstod bya/ de nas bskang zlog bya zhing gtor ma 'bul/ de rgyab rtsa gsum/ de rgyab a su ra bya'o/ /bzlog pa zhag bdun sogs bca' na rnga mong dang bcas las phran bcu rnams zhag bzhi thog nas bcas te gong bzhin 'don/ bong zhon las sbyor nyin bya/ sngon la byas kyang rung ste zhag la mi bzhag las sbyor gyi snga nyin nas zor lam phye dgos/ las sbyor nyin gtor dril bya thabs la rgyas par slang dgu ma yin na gzhung tshig dang bstun zhing yang dag gtor ma nas mtheb kyu gcig blangs la gshin rje la 'jog gshon rje nas blangs la rta mgrin/ de bzhin dpal dgu dril zhing mthar che mchog la dril lo/ /dbus mtha' med pa'i chos dbyings chen po zhes 'don zhing tshig dang bstun te gtor dril rgyas pa min na zlog gtor mtheb kyus gsos shing dbus mtha' med pa nas sngags ring mjug yan 'don/ de nas sgo dbye bya ba ni/ shar gyi sgo ma stag gdong zhes 'don zhing gser skyems mchod/ sgo bzhi nas de ltar bya zhing las bzhi'i rtsang shab/ de nas zlog gtor sgor khyer la/ skong bzlog bya ba ni/ hoX de ltar bskang bskang gsol gsol nas zhes 'don zhing zlog gtor sgor khyer te bde bar 'dug la/ snang srid thams cad

༄tshi/ /'don la 'bul/ de nas bhyo nyon cig snang srid lha ma srin sogs 'don gser skyems bya/ de nas srin mo za lam bcas bshams la zlog byed ma gcig ces sogs 'don/ de nas gtor zlog rim par khyer thabs/ dang po dkar gtor/ de rgyab glud/ 'dre mo bong zhon/ rnga mong / srin mo za lam/ zlog gtor/ zor dgu/ de nas rtsang ra rnams rim bzhin khyer/ gtor rgyab sar sleb tsa glud 'byung bzhis phul / bong zhon dang rnga mong rnams chos kun ye nas 'dus ma byas kyis phul/ glud bong zhon rnga mong de rnams mi bzhag par grong pas mi mthong bskyal/ de nas shing bong sar sna la srin mo za lam bzhag shing bong rgyab tu gtor zlog bzhag zor rtsang ra rim bzhin 'god/ snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang zhes dang gser skyems kha mchod bya/ brgyud gsum bla ma bya/ rakta gtor srid pa hu bya/ de nas zor dgu bya/ de nas bskong bzlog bya/ de nas zlog gtor bkyags shing / bhyo gzhan yang zlog cing sgyur ba ni zhes 'don bzlog pa dang rtsang ra me thab tu 'bul/ zlog gtor snod chang phud kyis bshal nas btab ste a su ra yi brag phug tu zhes 'don te kha yar gyus la/ rang rig mi 'gyur rdo rje'i srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas yar log sgo drung du las phran bcus mnan/ de steng gtor snod sbubs la zhi khro yongs rdzogs zhes rta bro brdung/ oX sumbha
